rationale: The description names conventional statistical tests, but also promises better prediction without specifying its method. No AI is asserted; the relationship of that predictive promise to the named statistical functions is unclear.
evidence_spans: Key statistical tests include t tests, one and two proportions, normality test, chi-square, and equivalence tests.
conflict_response: The named tests clearly establish conventional statistical functionality, but they do not establish that all predictive claims are implemented by those tests. Conversely, prediction without a method is not itself an AI assertion. Since the broader promise could be conventional or AI-dependent, I retain non_ai as the best-supported binary while marking it weak/forced rather than asserting the prediction mechanism.
